pages.title: A fictional catch-up
pages.instruction: These are role cards, not new facts about Ana’s life

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Long time no see! Are you still living in the same city?
lines.audioText: Long time no see! Are you still living in the same city?
lines.translation: Quanto tempo! Você ainda mora na mesma cidade?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: No, I moved to Porto in 2023
lines.audioText: No, I moved to Porto in 2023.
lines.translation: Não, eu me mudei para o Porto em 2023

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: How long have you lived there?
lines.audioText: How long have you lived there?
lines.translation: Há quanto tempo você mora lá?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Since 2023. I really like it, and I’ve made some good friends
lines.audioText: Since 2023. I really like it, and I’ve made some good friends.
lines.translation: Desde 2023. Gosto muito de lá e fiz bons amigos

questions.prompt: What positive change does she mention?
questions.answer: Ana has made some good friends

pages.title: Changes and things that continue
pages.instruction: These are role cards, not new facts about Ana’s life

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: That’s great. Have you taken up any new hobbies?
lines.audioText: That’s great. Have you taken up any new hobbies?
lines.translation: Que bom. Você começou algum hobby novo?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, I started a photography group in 2025
lines.audioText: Yes, I started a photography group in 2025.
lines.translation: Sim, comecei um grupo de fotografia em 2025

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Do you still go every week?
lines.audioText: Do you still go every week?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I do. We meet on Sundays. What’s changed in your life?
lines.audioText: I do. We meet on Sundays. What’s changed in your life?
lines.translation: Sim. Nos encontramos aos domingos. O que mudou na sua vida?

questions.prompt: What new hobby has Ana taken up?
questions.answer: Ana has joined a photography group

pages.title: Catch up after a long time
pages.instruction: Choose a change and tell me what is different now

pages.title: An update to the profile
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! Here’s the update for our fictional profile. I moved to Porto in 2023, and I’ve lived here since then. I started the photography group in 2025, and I still go on Sundays. I haven’t changed jobs, but I’ve finished an online course. I’m really enjoying the city now. What would you like to ask about my new routine?
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! Here’s the update for our fictional profile. I moved to Porto in 2023, and I’ve lived here since then. I started the photography group in 2025, and I still go on Sundays. I haven’t changed jobs, but I’ve finished an online course. I’m really enjoying the city now. What would you like to ask about my new routine?
